cards.back: Reviewing each card just before you'd forget it — maximizing retention per unit of study time.

cards.front: How do I replace these demo cards with my real Anki deck?
cards.back: Open Anki with the AnkiConnect add-on, then run pnpm sync-anki "Deck Name" and commit the regenerated flashcards.json.
The card flips. Use ← → to move between cards and s to shuffle.
